name: market_mount
prompt: One production-ready static transparent PNG game asset for a medieval goblin side-scrolling mobile game. Same NON-PIXEL flat hand-painted cartoon art as the reference: irregular clean painted contours, broad matte muted ochre wood/gray iron/olive/brick-red patches, just two close-value shades per material, minimal volume. Strict side elevation, slight hand-drawn wonkiness, no top-down or isometric view. Large readable silhouette at 100 pixels high. Whole object framed with margin, all feet and support posts on one consistent ground baseline. No background, no cast shadow, no halo, no scenery, no characters, no text, letters, numbers, interface, glow or pixel blocks. Redesign the reference into a tall goblin mount outfitter stable booth. High hitching arch with a very large saddle emblem at the top, leather saddles and reins on a timber rack, grounded hay trough and tied feed sack at side. Muted ochre rag canopy. No animals, characters or coins.
review: accepted: saddle crest, reins saddles hay; no animals; non-pixel painted transparent static bitmap
